verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents budgets with spending alerts and general-purpose REST APIs, a CLI and SDKs. None of it mentions a billing or cost query API, scheduled cost or usage exports, or resource-level cost granularity. Budgets and alerts are an adjacent cost-control feature, and the generic API, CLI and SDK docs are building blocks rather than evidence that cost data itself can be queried, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot
